features.label: Clinically proven leverage system
features.text: A patented biomechanical system backed by more than 20 studies utilizes dual Dynamic Force System straps and a single upright polycentric hinge to shift load away from the affected knee compartment.

features.label: Smartdosing dial adjustment
features.text: Tool-free dials allow you to independently fine-tune the tension of both straps with a single hand to control pain relief without removing your clothing.

features.label: Lightweight short frame
features.text: The 14.5 in. slender perforated frame is specifically designed for patients 5 ft 4 in. and under to prevent excess length from causing discomfort.

features.label: Secure sensil silicone liners
features.text: Skin-friendly coated liners and anti-migration strap technology grip the widest part of your calf to keep the brace firmly positioned during activity.

features.label: Pdac approved l1851 and l1843
features.text: Verified single upright knee brace with adjustable joints for medial or lateral control, available off-the-shelf or custom fitted.

indications: Mild to severe unicompartmental knee osteoarthritis (medial or lateral)
measurement: Measure your calf circumference 6 in. (15 cm) below the mid-patella with your leg in full extension. The short length 14.5 in. frame is recommended for patients with a leg length of 33.5 in. or less (generally 5 ft 4 in. and under). Do not guess your compartment; verify with your physician whether you need a medial or lateral configuration. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
